description: Bounded Bison nullable-nonterminal analysis using queue-based dependency propagation.

pinned_source.rights: The pinned Bison subtree includes the Bison General Public License in COPYING. The ports preserve the complete nullable.c notice and add a 2026 bounded-adaptation notice. No source code is copied.

contract.nullable_rule: A nonterminal is nullable if it has an empty production or a production whose every right-hand-side symbol is a nullable nonterminal. Any terminal in a right-hand side prevents that production from making its left-hand side nullable.
contract.algorithm_profile: Initialize nullable nonterminals from empty productions. For every nonempty all-nonterminal production, retain the number of remaining RHS occurrences. Process each newly nullable nonterminal once and decrement every matching RHS occurrence in every eligible rule; when a rule count reaches zero, enqueue its LHS if not already nullable.
contract.result_encoding: Return the nullable set as a bit mask; bit i is one exactly when nonterminal i is nullable.
contract.input_length: Exactly 3 plus the sum of 2+rhs_length for each production; maximum 323.

input.encoding: Production records use integer symbol IDs; no text grammar parsing is included.

output.meaning: Bit mask of nullable nonterminals in ascending symbol-ID order.
